question: metering-control-instrumentation-wiring
unit: $/m of installed cable route (GST exclusive, NZD)

band.unit: $/m of installed cable route (GST exclusive, NZD)
band.basis: Auckland, single-storey commercial, work at 2.5m max. Sum of: conduit 34.7-45.1 + cable material 2.98-3.03 + draw-in labour 2.5-6.0 + terminations 3.2-6.0 + testing 3.0-7.0 + scaffold 2.0-4.0 = $48.4-71.1/m. For the 200m nominal quantity: $9,680-14,230 (centre approx. $11,950). The dominant component (20mm conduit, ~63-72% of the total) is a cited but UNREVIEWED QV row whose material variant in the library is ambiguous; allowances carry 22-33% of the total, hence low confidence. If the higher of the two identical 20mm conduit rows ($60/m) proves to be the PVC rate, the band becomes roughly $74-85/m (~$15,000-17,000 for 200m). Excludes GST, preliminaries, margin, design/consent, devices, BMS controller/software, 230V supply, trenching/penetrations and after-hours/above-3m work.

QV containment (row t4:r3, +0-20% heavy duty) + fetched NZ vendor cable material (ASI, $2.98-3.03/m) + allowances for draw-in, 16 terminations, testing/loop checks, BMS interface & labelling + QV scaffold hire. 200m totals $9,890 (low) to $14,420 (high); mid ~$61/m ~ $12,150. Ex GST, excludes preliminaries/margin/design as instructed. Confidence low: QV conduit row unreviewed and the 20mm table carries two unexplained price points ($34.7 and $60/m), the cable is a single vendor quote, and allowances are ~20-32% of the total.

band.unit: $/m of installed control/instrumentation cable route including containment, ex GST, Auckland
band.basis: Sum of the seven components above for the pinned 200m / 8-run / 16-termination scope. QV conduit (t4:r3 low / t4:r14 high), fetched cable material price (source-1, $2.98/m), and five minor-labour allowances converted at the QV Electrician AKL rate ($83.65/hr). ALLOWANCES (draw-in, terminations, testing/BMS interface, schedule/labelling, scaffold) = $13.65/m low and $26.89/m high, i.e. ~27% and ~30% of each end of the band - just under the one-third threshold, which is why confidence is set LOW. Totals for the 200m nominal quantity: low $10,266, high $17,808, mid $14,038. No margin, preliminaries, GST, design, consent, devices, BMS software or 230V supply are included (excluded by scope).
